_comment: Uniform-FR campaign, Stage 5: ethane/LTA temperature sweep, frozen BEFORE any v2 run. Purpose: dial the SAME physical system across establishment regimes and separate two explanations the 300 K stage could not -- 'entropic barrier predicts FR benefit' vs 'establishment starvation predicts FR benefit'. On this axis they disagree: -T dS ~ const in kT while dU grows as 1/T, so if the benefit grows as T falls, starvation (not entropy share) carries it.
_provenance: Fresh preregistration; the closed 300 K stage (configs/uniform_campaign/lta_prereg.json) is untouched and reported as-is. Do not edit this file after the first v2 production run starts.
protocol_change_vs_v1: fr_start_steps 40000 -> 20000 (= end of ABF warmup). The v1 stage showed ABF converged before FR started; v2 removes that lateness uniformly at every T, including a fresh 300 K point so the sweep is internally matched. Everything else inherited.

sampler._budget_note: identical force-evaluation budget at every T; if ABF cannot converge at low T within it, that IS the starved regime -- censoring is reported, never imputed

reference_rule.kappa: kT / (0.07 rad)^2, so the window width is T-independent (0.07 rad)
reference_rule.n_steps: round(150000 * 300/T) -- diffusion D ~ kT, so window relaxation is T-scaled
reference_rule.unbiased_check_steps: 100000 for new T (wells-only validation at low T, declared); the validated 300 K artifact reference_T300.npz is REUSED as-is
reference_rule.acceptance: split-half dF agreement within 0.2 kT; unbiased overlap RMS reported

fr_rate_rule: per-T safety-only ladder {0.02, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20} under THIS prereg's sampler (fr_start 20000): largest rate with min ancestor ESS/N >= 0.30 and max lineage share <= 0.05 over the FR-active saves; chosen without reading any error metric; filled into per_T.fr_rate before that T's production
endpoints: per-T: the campaign rules (primary Delta I_F paired median, 10k bootstrap seed 20260829; final non-inferiority +5%; tau atlas convention; genealogy median-across-seeds). Sweep-level primary figure: benefit (-Delta I_F and S_eps) vs T, plotted against BOTH candidate predictors measured independently: (a) starvation = ABF-arm cage crossings before fr_start and ABF tau(e0/8); (b) entropy share = -T dS(T)/dF(T) from the references. The two hypotheses disagree on this axis; whichever tracks the benefit wins.
prohibited: tuning any knob on an error metric
adding temperatures after data are seen
editing this file after the first production run starts
